messages.content: The thermometer on the kitchen shelf read 27 degrees Celsius at noon today. It was beside the flour jar, away from the oven, and I took the reading before cooking lunch. This is a temperature reading from that spot and time; I have not set a temperature target for the kitchen.

On this morning's bus trip from Oak Street to the library, the journey took 38 minutes. The bus waited at the bridge while a delivery truck turned, and I stayed on until the library stop. I am recording the duration of that one trip; I have not chosen a regular departure time.
My basil plant has four yellow leaves this afternoon. I counted only leaves still attached to the plant. I do not yet know whether the cause is watering, light, or something else.
What did the parcel tracking page show when you checked it?
At 09:10 today, the tracking page showed the parcel at the East Depot. It did not give a delivery date, and I have no additional location update.
I counted 18 people entering the community hall between 2:00 and 2:15 this afternoon. This count does not include people who were already inside when I arrived.
The label on my blue mug says it holds 350 millilitres. I have not checked its capacity myself. The mug has a little moon 🌙 beside the handle, which is how I distinguish it from the other blue mug.

Yesterday's walk around the lake took me 52 minutes from the north gate back to the same gate. I stopped once to look at the birds. For next Saturday's walk, I have decided to allow a maximum of 40 minutes, because I need to meet my sister afterward. The 40 minutes is my chosen limit, not yesterday's measured duration.
The repair shop quoted 85 dollars to fix my desk lamp. That quote includes the switch and labour, but no new shade.
Have you chosen what to do with the lamp?
Yes. I have decided to have that shop repair the lamp for the quoted 85 dollars. I am not buying a replacement lamp.
The small rehearsal room has eight chairs. For Friday's choir practice, I have decided to book the large room instead of that small room, because we expect twelve singers.
My balcony gets direct sun for about two hours in the morning, based on my observations this week. I am considering growing mint there, but I have not chosen a plant yet.
The museum's evening tour begins at 6:30 p.m. on Thursday. That is what the booking page says today.
I have decided not to take that Thursday evening tour. I have not selected another tour or authorized anyone to book one for me.

The picnic forecast currently gives a 60 percent chance of rain on Sunday. My cousin Nia told me she has decided to reserve the covered pavilion for our Sunday picnic. I am reporting Nia's decision; I have not made a reservation myself.

For the neighbourhood supper this month, I have decided to make lentil soup. I have also decided to label the pot with the ingredients before serving it, since several neighbours asked about ingredients last time. These are my plans for this supper, and I have not offered to cook for any later event.
Is the beach route your final choice for Sunday's bike ride?

I have decided to use the beach route for Sunday's ride only if the wind forecast on Saturday is below 20 kilometres per hour. If it is 20 or above, I will postpone the ride rather than take that route.
My brother Leo told me, 'I have decided to take the train to our aunt's birthday lunch next Sunday.' That is Leo's travel decision. I have not chosen my own way to get there.
For my bedroom reading light, I have decided to buy the warm-white bulb. I have also decided to keep the existing lampshade. Both choices apply to this bedroom light, not the hallway light.
I am considering a Saturday pottery class at the community centre for next month. I have not enrolled, chosen a session, or decided to spend the class fee yet.
I am considering the wool blanket for the guest room, but I have not decided to buy it. What would you recommend for that room?
I recommend the cotton blanket for the guest room because it can be washed in your machine. This is my recommendation; you have not adopted it or authorized a purchase.

My colleague Mira says she is considering moving the book club to the cafe near the station for November. She explicitly said she has not chosen a venue yet. I am passing along Mira's consideration, not choosing for the club.
I am considering swimming before work on Tuesdays if the pool opens at six next month. I do not yet know its opening hours, and even if it opens at six I have not committed to going.
I have decided not to buy the red raincoat for this winter. I have not chosen a different coat, and this decision does not mean I dislike every red item of clothing.
Would you like the midnight train for the trip to the reunion?
I have rejected the midnight train for this reunion trip. I have decided to take the 9 a.m. train instead. This is a travel choice, not permission for you to buy a ticket.

Our treasurer Omar told me he has rejected the proposal to raise the garden club's annual fee this year. Omar made that decision in his treasurer role. I am reporting it and am not claiming that the whole committee has voted.
For the family photo album, I have decided not to include the blurry beach photo. I have not rejected the other beach photos and have not decided which cover to use.
